claim: Campaigns (outbound lists) shipped on 2026-08-18 as an Enterprise feature that support must switch on. They are created only through the API; the portal shows progress. Each request carries 1-10,000 recipients, up to 1,000,000 per campaign. A campaign is cancelled after seven days. Failed recipients are not retried. There is no per-campaign webhook. De-duplication happens only when the caller supplies an id. The calling window cannot cross midnight or be edited after creation. An agent's business hours that conflict with the window make recipients fail immediately instead of waiting.

verification.note: Every rule re-found verbatim in batch-calling.md (Enterprise via support; 1-10,000 per request, 1,000,000 per campaign; seven-day cancel; 'Failed recipients are not retried automatically'; no campaign webhook; de-dup only with caller ids; window cannot span midnight and cannot be changed after creation; agent hours fail recipients rather than wait). The Flipt flag batch_calls (frontend) is off with no rollouts, consistent with API-only.

claim: Contact data model: a contact is name*, phone_number*, email and contact_metadata.company. There are no consent, opt-out, DND or timezone fields, and no suppression-list endpoint anywhere in the 110 operations. 'Contacts' was renamed 'Memory' on 2026-05-12.

verification.note: POST /contacts schema re-read: name and phone_number required, email, contact_metadata. 0 hits for consent ledger, dnc, do_not_call, blocklist, opt_out or dnd across the spec ('suppress' hits are the noise-isolation field suppression_level). 2026-05-12 entry: 'Contacts is now Memory'.

claim: Opt-out is detected after the call, not enforced: the post-call LLM-judge payload carries opted_in and no_opt_out booleans ('false if the caller asked to be removed'), and the buyer has to act on them.

verification.note: Field definitions re-read in webhooks.md: opted_in = 'whether the caller expected the call and remembered opting in' (an LLM judgement of the conversation, not a consent record); no_opt_out false 'if the caller asked to be removed'. claim: Billing mechanics: calls are metered per second and aggregated across calls into whole minutes. no-answer and hangup_on_voicemail calls are billed a flat 5 s; failed and user-canceled calls are not billed. Five AI chat messages count as one minute. Billing thresholds trigger invoices and are not spending caps.

verification.note: usage.md re-read: seconds aggregated across calls into whole minutes; no-answer and hangup_on_voicemail recorded as a flat 5 s; failed and user-canceled not billed.

claim: Capacity: each workspace has a concurrency limit and a call-attempts-per-second (CAPS) limit. Warm-transfer attempts start new outbound calls that count against CAPS, so transfer-heavy campaigns can starve. Subaccounts share the parent's limits. Over-limit calls get HTTP 429 or a short queue.

verification.note: concurrency.md re-read: CAPS covers voice-call API, campaigns and warm transfers; 429 on excess.

The docs' example base URL, wss://webrtc-us.synthflow.ai/ws-audio, does not resolve in public DNS (NXDOMAIN, 2026-10-20), so the live media host is issued per session. The older widget websocket endpoint was deprecated on 2026-06-15, as announced in the 2026-05-27 changelog entry.

verification.note: Two errors. (1) The 2026-05-27 changelog entry says the old endpoint (widget.synthflow.ai/websocket/token/{assistant_id}) 'was deprecated on June 15, 2026'; 2026-05-27 is the announcement date. If the $30k/yr floor is a usage commitment (assumed in pricing.py), the effective rate is INR 47.5/min at 5,000 min/month and INR 23.75 at 10,000, and the floor stops binding at roughly 9,000-16,000 min/month; if it is a fee on top, add INR 47.5, 23.75 and 9.5 per minute at 5k, 10k and 25k. Two non-native routes remain: a Synthflow PoP in India (offered on request, vendor-claimed, SYN-21b), or a buyer-built bridge from an Indian CPaaS media stream such as Exotel AgentStream (EXO-13) into Synthflow's WebSocket media API (SYN-24). Whether either is lawful for a 140/1600-series deployment is not established.
